manaNeeded: {0} plus the mana cost of the creature in your hand
easyPrerequisites: Werefox Bodyguard must be exiled by Hostage Taker, and Glorious Protector must begin in hand. (This starting order is not fixed, and their initial positions may be interchanged as necessary.)
description:
Cast Glorious Protector for its mana cost.
When Glorious Protector enters, it exiles Hostage Taker until Glorious Protector leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Glorious Protector's ETB.
When Hostage Taker leaves the battlefield, Werefox Bodyguard is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When Werefox Bodyguard enters, it exiles Glorious Protector until Werefox Bodyguard leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Werefox Bodyguard's ETB.
When Glorious Protector leaves the battlefield, Hostage Taker is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When Hostage Taker enters, it exiles Werefox Bodyguard until Hostage Taker leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Hostage Taker's ETB.
When Werefox Bodyguard leaves the battlefield, Glorious Protector is returned from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
